additions.description: Supports Authorization header with Bearer token format and also accepts token in 'token' header
additions.reasoning: The specification states that a token must be supplied but does not specify the format or header name; the code accepts tokens from 'Authorization' header with Bearer scheme or from a 'token' header, which is an implementation detail not required by the specification.

additions.description: Implements a MongoDB counter collection to generate unique 'id' values for ratings
additions.reasoning: The specification requires unique ids but does not specify how ids are generated; the code uses a counters collection to generate sequential ids, which is an implementation detail not required by the specification.

additions.description: Rounds rating values to two decimal places
additions.reasoning: The specification states rating is an integer between 1 and 5; the code converts rating to float and rounds to two decimals, which is an addition beyond the specification.

omissions.description: POST /ratings does not reject if the user has already rated the same dish
omissions.reasoning: The specification states 'POST /ratings request is only allowed once for a given user for a given dish' but the code inserts a new rating without checking for existing rating by the same user for the dish.

omissions.description: PUT /ratings/{id} does not verify that the rating value is an integer between 1 and 5
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires rating to be an integer between 1 and 5 but the code accepts any float value and does not validate the range or type.

omissions.description: POST /ratings does not verify that the rating value is an integer between 1 and 5
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires rating to be an integer between 1 and 5 but the code accepts any float value and does not validate the range or type.

omissions.description: POST /ratings and PUT /ratings/{id} do not verify that the dish_id exists before creating or updating a rating
omissions.reasoning: The specification implies ratings are for existing dishes; the code calls dish_exists but does not handle 401 Unauthorized from dishes service properly and may allow rating non-existent dishes if dish_exists returns False without error.

omissions.description: DELETE /ratings/{id} does not verify that the rating to delete belongs to the user issuing the request
omissions.reasoning: The specification states that PUT and DELETE requests update or delete the rating given by that user for the dish of the given id; the code deletes by dish_id and user_id but does not check if the rating id corresponds to the user or if the id is the rating id or dish id, causing possible ambiguity.

omissions.description: GET /ratings returns average ratings for all dishes but does not support filtering by dish_id or other query parameters
omissions.reasoning: The specification does not explicitly require filtering on GET /ratings but the code does not support any query parameters; no omission if spec does not require filtering.

omissions.description: Does not return 400 Bad Request when dish_id or rating fields are missing or invalid in PUT /ratings/{id}
omissions.reasoning: The code returns 400 if dish_id or rating missing or invalid, so no omission here.

omissions.description: Does not return 404 Not Found if rating to update or delete does not exist for the user
omissions.reasoning: The code returns 404 if no rating found to update or delete, so no omission here.
